_comment: Seed values, NOT production truth. mean_confidence and empty_detection_rate come from the Deliverable B test-set evaluation; diameter_p50_mm is the worked example in docs/size-estimation.md (a typical medium crown at the default 1 m camera height). After the first healthy production window (a week or so of normal field traffic), re-capture all three from Prometheus and overwrite this file - the queries to run are in docs/retraining.md. Until then, drift alerts compare field behaviour against lab numbers, so treat them as advisory.
window: manual baseline from Deliverable B test set
